text:
lucas (DevEx): quick round: I ran a scan of optimize-toolkit and found 6 small issues we can knock out in one afternoon. thinking a 'harvest' pass for micro-PRs. list incoming.

ben (Eng-Platform): drop the list pls. I can take async example and demo harness.

lucas (DevEx): short list:
1) python SDK example still shows `sync_stream()`; should be `stream_async()` pattern with async for loop.
2) perf example uses `requests` + loop; swap to aiohttp or the SDK streaming helper.
3) caching doc references the old 'proto' repo path; redirect to new examples bucket.
4) quantization page mentions legacy codec `q4_0` without migration notes for q4_1 and q8_0.
5) sidebar link to 'optkit' misspells the slug; 2 links broken.
6) example snippets lack snippet ids for telemetry.

alejandra (Docs): thanks. I can own link redirects and add short migration note on quant. I'll also normalize the example headings.

nora (Product): for quant migration blurb, keep it conservative: recommend q4_1 for cost constrained and q8_0 on Dedicated for better latency. Add a validated note about running token-cost checks.

ben (Eng-Platform): I'll rework the async streaming sample. here's a compact pattern we use: ```python
async for chunk in client.optimize.stream_async(model='open-small', prompt='hi'):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
I'll include a small `wrk` script for load simulation.

alejandra (Docs): remember to add a comment about `min_batch_size` effects and show how to simulate warm vs cold cache. Otherwise readers misinterpret latency numbers.

lucas (DevEx): filing small issues now and tagging `docs:micro` + `optimize`. also prepping PR seeds for 1 and 2 and will push drafts.

ci-bot: docs build will run on push. preview links will be posted here. :gear: 

ben (Eng-Platform): pushed `ben/optkit-async-sample` branch. Preview: https://deploy-preview-2387--redwood-docs.example.com/optimize-toolkit/streaming (linkcheck: 1 warning).

alejandra (Docs): patched redirects in `alejandra/optkit-linkfix`. preview: https://deploy-preview-2388--redwood-docs.example.com (checks green).

lucas (DevEx): merged both PRs after QA and mkdocs preview. I added a tiny CHANGELOG note: "optimize-toolkit: updated streaming examples, fixed links, clarified quant guidance."

nora (Product): approved the wording in PR. small follow-up: create issue to add `data-snippet-id` attributes so analytics can attach. I'll log that.

ben (Eng-Platform): added a one-liner to the caching doc: "proactively prefetch high-frequency prefixes at startup to reduce cold-start token cost".

alejandra (Docs): closing checklist: sidebar fixed, quant blurb added, streaming example converted. marking harvest items done.

lucas (DevEx): thanks everyone. we'll run another sweep next sprint for remaining optimize-toolkit TODOs. drop anything small with `optimize:micro` in #docs.
